observed_current_controls: ReleaseArchivePolicy v1 requires ZIP_STORED and forbids ZIP64, non-ASCII paths, comments/extra metadata and directory entries.
ReleaseArchiveReceipt already binds archive_sha256, archive_size and member_count in addition to manifest_sha256 and archive policy identity.
ReleaseManifest binds every payload member to exact canonical path, SHA-256 and uncompressed size.

verify_release_archive currently accepts the entire archive as bytes, reads every member into a member_bytes dictionary and then rebuilds a second canonical archive byte string for byte-for-byte equality.
The portable transaction core is planning-only and does not supply a streaming archive-consumption path.

important_refinement_from_e1.reason: The admitted generation-3 release ZIP policy is ZIP_STORED only and ZIP64 is forbidden, so classic compressed-to-expanded ratio bombs are not the primary current risk. Generic max_compression_ratio should therefore not become a new acceptance authority for v1.
important_refinement_from_e1.source_mechanism: archive_bytes is already fully resident; archive.read materializes all members; canonical re-encoding materializes another archive-sized bytes object. Peak verifier memory therefore scales with total release size rather than a small streaming window.

minimal_architecture_delta_candidate.name: MANIFEST_BOUND_STREAMING_RELEASE_VERIFIER
install_lane_contract: Require an expected ReleaseArchiveReceipt for install/handoff verification rather than treating it as optional.
Accept a file path or seekable file object for install-lane verification so the outer ZIP need not be loaded wholly into RAM.
Stat and stream-hash the artifact first; require exact archive_size and archive_sha256 from the expected receipt before member consumption.
Open the verified artifact with allowZip64=False and retain existing deterministic metadata/path/member-set checks.
Read the embedded canonical manifest with an explicit small manifest-byte ceiling, then use its exact file sizes and hashes as the payload byte budget.
Stream each member in bounded chunks, enforcing exact expected per-file byte count and SHA-256 and an exact total expected payload budget; do not retain all member bytes simultaneously.

For the install lane, do not rebuild a second full canonical ZIP in memory after exact outer artifact identity has matched a trusted pre-handoff receipt whose build lane already proved canonical encoding.
Continue into the separate private-staging extraction boundary only after archive identity/member verification succeeds.
minimal_architecture_delta_candidate.build_or_source_only_lane: The existing full canonical re-encode verifier may remain for build/source tests where proving deterministic encoding without an external trusted receipt is the objective; it should not automatically define the memory profile of the local install lane.

resource_policy.max_members: BOUND_BY_EXPECTED_RECEIPT_AND_MANIFEST; classic ZIP hard maximum remains a format fence, not the product budget
resource_policy.max_compression_ratio: NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_CURRENT_ZIP_STORED_V1; reconsider only if a future compression policy is admitted
resource_policy.peak_payload_memory_target: O(chunk_size + manifest_bytes + ZIP metadata), not O(total_payload_bytes)

why_this_is_smaller_than_a_generic_archi: It exploits current F2's exact deterministic ZIP policy instead of supporting arbitrary ZIP/tar features.
It reuses the existing exact archive receipt and per-file manifest rather than creating a second package truth store.
It removes redundant ratio heuristics under ZIP_STORED and converts generic resource limits into exact release-specific budgets.
It separates build-time canonical-encoding proof from install-time exact-artifact consumption, allowing the latter to be streaming and cheaper.

counterhypotheses.statement: Real F2 release artifacts remain so small that all-at-once verification is operationally negligible.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: Measure current verifier peak memory across increasing canonical ZIP_STORED payload sizes and compare with a bounded streaming prototype or analytical lower bound.

counterhypotheses.statement: A trusted exact archive receipt is unavailable at local handoff, so install-time canonical re-encoding cannot be safely removed.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: Trace WP1107/WP1110 handoff receipts and the one-handoff installer input; if exact archive_sha256/policy identity is not available before install verification, retain canonical encoding proof or strengthen the handoff subject binding first.

counterhypotheses.statement: Future compressed release policy will replace ZIP_STORED soon.
counterhypotheses.impact: Then streamed exact expanded-size enforcement remains useful, but compression-method and CPU/ratio policy must be re-evaluated under that successor policy rather than hardcoded now.

next_exact_action: E3 local exact-source reproduction: measure current verify_release_archive incremental peak allocation versus canonical ZIP_STORED payload size. Preserve LOCAL_DETERMINISTIC_REPRODUCTION_ONLY scope. If memory scales approximately linearly with total payload as source predicts, hand a bounded streaming-verifier candidate to Trigger4 for an implementation/benchmark workpackage; otherwise terminalize the optimization hypothesis.
